name: Rin Kazamatsuri
bio: Speedboat ace with teal hair and orange goggles. She takes the Hayate down the valley's rivers to break Commodore Kurogane's Iron Lotus fleet, with Tomo fixing whatever she breaks.

portrait.subject: Rin Kazamatsuri, a determined young adult speedboat pilot with short spiky teal hair, orange goggles pushed up on her forehead, a white racing jacket with cyan panels and a red collar, a confident grin
portrait.background: bright turquoise river spray with a few pink cherry petals

request: Rin here, on the Hayate's radio! Kurogane's fleet has dammed every river in the valley and I'm going downstream to open them up. Want to ride along? 🚤
hello: Welcome aboard, {you}! Hold on to something. The Hayate doesn't do slow.
Channel open! Tomo says hi. Well, he says 'don't break the hydrofoils again'. Same thing.
about: I'm Rin, pilot of the Hayate: twin cannons, a missile rack and hydrofoils that throw her right out of the water. Tomo built her; I mostly crash her. Kurogane's fleet is choking the valley, so I'm sailing down to stop him.
how: Steer with ← → or A D, throttle with ↑, brake with ↓. Hold J (or Z) to fire, K for a homing missile, Space to JUMP. On a phone, drag the left side to steer, tap JUMP and MSL, and auto-fire shoots for you.
tips: Jump is your best friend: in the air you clear mines, booms, sandbars, bullets and even laser beams. It refills over time, and every kill tops it up.
Watch your fuel! Brake while you're over a FUEL depot to drink more, and stop shooting when one's in front of you. Yes, you can blow them up. I have. Twice.
Red lines mean a gun has already picked where it's shooting. Slide out of the line and the shot misses.
Tanks paint a long red laser before they fire. Don't sit in it!
Boss cores start shielded: break the hulls, pylons or batteries first. Missiles home in on whatever can be hit.
When a boss goes into OVERDRIVE, red lanes flash on the water before its beams fire. Get out of the lane, or jump right over the beam.
Cores get banked at every dock and when a run ends, so even a crash pays. Reinforced Hull and Hot Rounds are great first buys.
chat: Tomo painted a little cherry blossom on the Hayate's bow. Don't tell him I noticed.
The jade river has waterfalls everywhere. I keep wanting to jump one. Tomo keeps saying no.
Kurogane's flagship has a giant iron lotus on the front. Who designs these things?
Speed raiders have a ram spike on the bow. Rude. Shoot them before they get close!
I named the twin cannons. Left is Ume, right is Sakura. They don't know.
SOUEN has two hulls and one very angry core in the middle. We've met.
nudge: The Hayate's fuelled up and Tomo just tuned the hydrofoils. Want to take her out?
River's running fast today. Perfect for a run, {you}!
idle: It's been {ago}! The Hayate's been sitting at the dock gathering cherry petals.
{ago} without a run? Kurogane's probably building another fortress.
progress: Your best run is {best} points! Think we can beat it?
{cores} cores in the bank. That's a skill or two, {you}!
{wins} rivers freed so far. Kurogane must hate us!

questions.q: When something's in the way: shoot it or jump it?
a: Classic! Just don't shoot the fuel depots. Ask me how I know.
Ha! That's my favourite button too. Air time is happy time.
Jump AND shoot? Get the Landing Barrage skill. You're going to love it.

questions.q: Which skill branch do you go for first?
a: Smart. More hull means more mistakes allowed. I need those.
More barrels! Tomo says four is 'excessive'. Tomo is wrong.
Fuel efficiency and longer boosts? Very sensible. Tomo would approve.

update: Tomo just rolled out a Hayate update: version {version}! Come try it out!
bye: Hayate, signing off! Ride the current, {you}!
Back to the dock. Talk soon!
